finding.heading: ### R1-1 The nightly job never looks for duplicate numbers
finding.body:
The duplicate check rule says the job does not look for duplicate invoice numbers, although the gap check next to it relies on the numbers being trustworthy. Cited: spec lines 18-19 (before version).
An implementer who follows IN-5 builds a reconciliation job that never reports two invoices with the same number.
Protected requirement: line 18 (the gap check must hold).

full_diff:
--- before.md
+++ after.md
@@ -14,9 +14,9 @@
 
 ## 3. Numbering and checks
 
-- **IN-3 Sequence.** Invoice numbers are taken from one sequence that is shared by all regions, in the order in which invoices are issued.
+- **IN-3 Sequence.** Each region has its own invoice sequence, and every invoice number carries the code of its region.
 - **IN-4 Gap check.** The nightly reconciliation job reports every gap in the invoice sequence to the finance team.
-- **IN-5 Duplicate check.** The reconciliation job does not look for duplicate invoice numbers.
+- **IN-5 Duplicate check.** The reconciliation job reports every number that appears twice in the shared sequence of all regions.
 - **IN-6 Time of assignment.** A number is assigned at the moment the invoice is issued, not when the draft is created.
 
 ## 4. Archive
